activation: First strictly positive finite nonnegative load, determined forward in time; exclude history preceding activation. Later zero loads remain valid.
invalid_load: Nonfinite, negative, or malformed decimal invalidates every history or outcome window containing that observation.
numeric_encoding: Semicolon-delimited quoted or unquoted decimal-comma tokens, compared using exact Decimal values; no epsilon.
label: Outcome load strictly greater than cutoff is rise; strictly less is fall; exact ties are excluded.
dst_policy: Conservatively exclude any history-to-outcome span intersecting the entire last Sunday of March or October, avoiding end-of-interval ambiguity.
independence: Support counts are not independent sample sizes. Shared grid and calendar effects require client and calendar block controls in subsequent evaluation.
failure_policy: Stop this exact task on failed train/development support; do not retune cutoff, horizon, ties or thresholds after counts. Passing support does not authorize held-out access or candidate scoring.
